reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents OneCoin's DealShaker as an e-commerce platform and promotes its claimed benefits for merchants and consumers. It encourages interest in OneCoin and platform participation, but the video does not state a concrete investment return, request payment or sensitive data, or establish a deceptive money or data flow.

citations.quote: OneCoin's DealShaker, an e-commerce platform designed to enhance the OneCoin ecosystem by allowing merchants and consumers to easily use OneCoins to buy and sell goods and services
Only OneCoin is accepted on the Deal Shaker platform, though cash can also be used to pay for up to half of the cost goods or services
it also increases the usability of OneCoin, thus increasing its value
So for consumers looking for a new crypto, OneCoin is looking like a good option
By joining DealShaker, merchants gain access to the entire universe of OneCoin users

opening.argument: Judge, the pitch links participation in OneCoin to a claim of rising value. It says DealShaker increases the coin's usability, "thus increasing its value," then calls OneCoin a good option for someone looking for a new crypto. The marketplace gives that choice a practical rationale: shoppers are told that only OneCoin is accepted there, apart from cash covering up to half the cost. Read together, those claims steer a consumer toward acquiring and using the coin while inviting them to expect appreciation. The goods-and-services framing does not erase that asset pitch.

citations.quote: it also increases the usability of OneCoin, thus increasing its value
So for consumers looking for a new crypto, OneCoin is looking like a good option
Only OneCoin is accepted on the Deal Shaker platform, though cash can also be used to pay for up to half of the cost goods or services

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense is right that no return figure or explicit purchase instruction appears. But those are not the only ways to solicit interest in an appreciating token. Calling the coin a good option immediately after saying platform use increases its value connects the proposed choice to the anticipated benefit. The OneCoin-only payment condition makes the commercial pitch part of that same pathway, not an independent answer to it.

citations.quote: it also increases the usability of OneCoin, thus increasing its value
So for consumers looking for a new crypto, OneCoin is looking like a good option
Only OneCoin is accepted on the Deal Shaker platform

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The cited language describes a claimed benefit of a marketplace, not an offer to sell coins or a promise that a buyer's holdings will appreciate. "Good option" is a broad endorsement, while the payment rule explains how purchases of goods and services work. The argument supplies no cited instruction to buy or hold OneCoin for a return, and no deceptive transaction is established.

citations.quote: an e-commerce platform designed to enhance the OneCoin ecosystem by allowing merchants and consumers to easily use OneCoins to buy and sell goods and services
So for consumers looking for a new crypto, OneCoin is looking like a good option

opening.argument: Judge, consider how the assurances compound. The video claims the marketplace increases OneCoin's value, reports a user base exceeding three million, and says the platform reached 32,000 merchants and 200,000 users in three months. It also presents its customer-checking protocols as ensuring legitimate transactions. None of those claims independently verifies the coin's value or the safety of participating. Together they give an appreciating-asset pitch the appearance of scale, momentum, and trustworthiness, encouraging confidence that the cited material itself cannot substantiate.

citations.quote: it also increases the usability of OneCoin, thus increasing its value
a user base that now exceeds three million users
In only three months since its launch, OneCoin's DealShaker platform has grown to include 32,000 merchants and 200,000 OneCoin users.
it's know your customer kyc protocols which ensures that both merchants and consumers are acting in legitimate transactions

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense treats the absence of a specified return or data request as decisive. That overlooks the cumulative pitch: claimed value growth is reinforced with rapid-adoption figures and a categorical assurance about legitimate transactions. The cited statements show what viewers are asked to trust, not independent proof that those assurances hold. A careful reading should weigh that promotional combination, even without a quoted percentage gain.

citations.quote: thus increasing its value
In only three months since its launch, OneCoin's DealShaker platform has grown to include 32,000 merchants and 200,000 OneCoin users.
kyc protocols which ensures that both merchants and consumers are acting in legitimate transactions

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Unverified promotional claims are not, by themselves, evidence of a scam. The figures concern marketplace participation; the protocol claim concerns transaction counterparties. Neither establishes that a viewer is asked to buy a token for investment returns, nor that any stated figure or assurance is false. The described use remains buying and selling goods and services on a marketplace.

citations.quote: In only three months since its launch, OneCoin's DealShaker platform has grown to include 32,000 merchants and 200,000 OneCoin users.
allowing merchants and consumers to easily use OneCoins to buy and sell goods and services

opening.argument: Judge, the commerce description is doing promotional work for the coin. The title announces a crypto consumer platform; the narration then describes a marketplace where only OneCoin is accepted, says the platform increases OneCoin's value, and recommends OneCoin as a good option for consumers seeking a new crypto. Those steps turn an apparent platform update into a case for entering the coin's ecosystem. The argument is not merely that goods can be purchased: exclusive coin use is presented as the mechanism supporting the asset's value, followed by an endorsement of the asset itself.

citations.quote: OneCoin Adds Crypto Consumer Platform
Only OneCoin is accepted on the Deal Shaker platform
it also increases the usability of OneCoin, thus increasing its value
So for consumers looking for a new crypto, OneCoin is looking like a good option

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense describes a merchant-and-consumer marketplace, but that account leaves out why the narration calls increased coin value a benefit and ends by recommending the crypto. Its examples of ordinary transactions show the wrapper for the appeal; they do not make the value claim disappear. The absence of a payment form or specified return limits what can be concluded about a transaction, but not whether the message promotes participation on an appreciation premise.

citations.quote: it also increases the usability of OneCoin, thus increasing its value
So for consumers looking for a new crypto, OneCoin is looking like a good option

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Promotion is not the same as a scam. The video describes a platform for buying and selling goods and services and makes a favorable, unverified claim about the coin's value. The prosecution's reframing still lacks a cited token sale, an instruction to invest or hold for gains, or evidence that the marketplace claim is deceptive. The commerce context therefore remains the more directly supported reading.
